scriptedVariables.name: splunkCreateAlertBody
scriptedVariables.script: const issue=(scope&&scope.issue)||(scope&&scope.payload&&scope.payload.issue)||{};const fields=issue.fields||{};const clean=(value)=>String(value||'').replace(/[\r\n\t]+/g,' ').replace(/["\\]+/g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();const value=(configured,defaultValue)=>configured===undefined||configured===null||String(configured).trim()===''?defaultValue:String(configured);const issueKey=issue.key||'incident';const summary=clean(fields.summary||issueKey)||'Jira incident';const alertName=clean('Jira '+issueKey+' - '+summary).slice(0,140);const searchTemplate={{{toJSON _flow.SPLUNK_DEFAULT_SEARCH}}};const jiraBaseUrl='{{baseUrl}}';const search=String(searchTemplate||'search index=main (error OR failure) | head 100').replace(/\$\{JIRA_ISSUE_KEY\}/g,issueKey).replace(/\$\{JIRA_SUMMARY\}/g,summary);const description='Created from Jira incident '+issueKey+' - '+summary+'. Jira URL: '+jiraBaseUrl+'/browse/'+issueKey;const pairs=[['name',alertName],['search',search],['description',description],['is_scheduled','1'],['enableSched','1'],['disabled','0'],['cron_schedule',value({{{toJSON _flow.SPLUNK_CRON_SCHEDULE}}},'*/5 * * * *')],['dispatch.earliest_time',value({{{toJSON _flow.SPLUNK_DISPATCH_EARLIEST_TIME}}},'-15m')],['dispatch.latest_time',value({{{toJSON _flow.SPLUNK_DISPATCH_LATEST_TIME}}},'now')],['alert_type','number of events'],['alert_comparator','greater than'],['alert_threshold','0'],['alert.digest_mode','1'],['alert.track','1'],['alert.severity',value({{{toJSON _flow.SPLUNK_ALERT_SEVERITY}}},'4')],['alert.expires',value({{{toJSON _flow.SPLUNK_ALERT_EXPIRES}}},'24h'),],['alert.suppress','1'],['alert.suppress.period',value({{{toJSON _flow.SPLUNK_ALERT_SUPPRESS_PERIOD}}},'30m')],['request.ui_dispatch_app',value({{{toJSON _flow.SPLUNK_APP}}},'search')],['request.ui_dispatch_view','search']];const webhookUrl=value({{{toJSON _flow.SPLUNK_CREATED_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL}}},'');if(webhookUrl&&!webhookUrl.startsWith('https://your-')){pairs.push(['actions','webhook'],['action.webhook','1'],['action.webhook.param.url',webhookUrl]);}else{pairs.push(['actions','']);}const encode=(input)=>encodeURIComponent(input===undefined||input===null?'':String(input));return pairs.map(([key,val])=>encodeURIComponent(key)+'='+encode(val)).join('&');

description: Create a Splunk saved-search alert when a Jira incident is created.

flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key containing incidents that should create Splunk alerts.

flowVariables.name: INCIDENT_ISSUE_TYPE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira issue type that represents incidents in the configured project.

flowVariables.name: IHUB_JIRA_ACCOUNT_ID
flowVariables.instruction: Atlassian accountId used by the iHub integration user. Used to prevent Jira/Splunk loops.

flowVariables.name: SPLUNK_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Splunk management API base URL, including port 8089 for Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud REST API access.

flowVariables.name: SPLUNK_APP
flowVariables.instruction: Splunk app namespace that should own the saved-search alert.

flowVariables.name: SPLUNK_DEFAULT_SEARCH
flowVariables.instruction: SPL used for alerts created from Jira. The tokens ${JIRA_ISSUE_KEY} and ${JIRA_SUMMARY} are replaced before the alert is created.

flowVariables.name: SPLUNK_CRON_SCHEDULE
flowVariables.instruction: Cron schedule for the created Splunk saved-search alert.

flowVariables.name: SPLUNK_DISPATCH_EARLIEST_TIME
flowVariables.instruction: Earliest dispatch time for the saved search.

flowVariables.name: SPLUNK_DISPATCH_LATEST_TIME
flowVariables.instruction: Latest dispatch time for the saved search.

flowVariables.name: SPLUNK_ALERT_SEVERITY
flowVariables.instruction: Splunk alert severity. Splunk uses 1 DEBUG, 2 INFO, 3 WARN, 4 ERROR, 5 SEVERE, 6 FATAL.

flowVariables.name: SPLUNK_ALERT_EXPIRES
flowVariables.instruction: How long the triggered alert remains visible in Splunk.

flowVariables.name: SPLUNK_ALERT_SUPPRESS_PERIOD
flowVariables.instruction: Splunk suppression period for repeated results from the created alert.

flowVariables.name: SPLUNK_CREATED_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Optional webhook URL to attach to the created Splunk alert. Leave empty to create a tracked Splunk alert without a webhook action.
